attempt_history.root_cause: The benchmark generator posts to LLM_GATEWAY_URL as an exact endpoint, but the isolated preview was configured with the /v1 base instead of /v1/chat/completions.

post_run_root_cause.detail: Candidate publication intentionally strips content_hash from pipeline version document_results, while pipeline_corpus_snapshot read only that stripped field. The resulting Gold provenance contained four empty document hashes even though the immutable knowledge document records retained valid hashes.
post_run_root_cause.minimal_fix: Recover missing document hashes from the immutable knowledge document record and reject corpus snapshots that still lack a 64-character hexadecimal document hash.
post_run_root_cause.review_admission_fix: Treat every failed Gold v2 qualification check except manual review completion, leakage warning reasons, and explicit rejection of blocking leakage as a structural pre-review blocker. Enforce the same distinction in the API and UI.
post_run_root_cause.authorized_regeneration_environment_root: The isolated preview server started at 2026-08-21T02:02:42Z before b6752329 was committed at 2026-08-21T02:40:42Z. Its /app bind mount contained the fixed source, but Uvicorn was not running with reload, so the authorized regeneration executed the stale in-memory implementation.
post_run_root_cause.post_failure_action: Stop without retry, retain both datasets as diagnostic-only, restart only modelmirror-rag-r3-preview-server-v2, and run an unbilled preflight.
